```plato

// A spatial metaball: a radial falloff kernel centered at a point. Influence
// is Strength at the center and falls to zero at Radius. Negative strengths
// carve away from the surface.
type MetaBall3D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Strength: Number;
}
```
